column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 early seasonal / Prica route

column2: Hey, hey! Flowers are so $$可愛い$$! So many different ones bloom in spring...
Just looking at them makes me feel all happy!
Hey, $$おにいちゃん$$, did you know...?
$$ひまわり$$s turn their faces toward the sun when they bloom. They're my very favorite flowers!
They say spring has its $$七草$$... I wonder if autumn does too?
What?! It does?! Waaah... Amazing, amazing!
Then we can make $$七草粥$$ with them... Oh. You can't eat those?
This is when my favorite flowers, $$デントロビウム$$s, bloom!
Heehee! See? I know a few things too!
Spring is so peaceful... Morning! How are you feeling?
$$おにいちゃん$$!
You look like a little frog that just woke up from hibernation!
Waaah! What a wonderful morning!
Do your best at work today too, $$おにいちゃん$$!
Mornin', $$おにいぢゃん$$...
It was so hot last night... I couldn't sleep very well...
Whoa! Looks like another hot day from the start!
Maybe I'll take my crayons and head up the hill again today...
It's almost my favorite season for drawing, after all!
Mornin', $$おにいちゃ〜ん$$!
The breeze is finally starting to cool down!
Morning.
Haaaah... Look! My breath is this white!
Even though it's this cold...
let's do our best all day!
Morning. Brrr... it's cold...
Hey, $$おにいちゃん$$... Is it about time I could sleep in the same bed with you...?
$$おにいちゃ〜ん$$!
It's so hot today, I'm completely wilting!
Hey, hey, on a day this hot...
Want to $$水浴び$$ together?
Let's $$水浴び$$!
Let's not $$水浴び$$!
Y-yeah, you're right!
You're still in the middle of $$リハビリ$$... I'm sorry!
A-a $$台風$$! We have to stop the leak, quick!
I'm sorry, $$おにいちゃん$$...
I made you push yourself even though you're not well yet...
But I'm so glad! That you're here, $$おにいちゃん$$...
If I were all alone... I'd be bawling my eyes out by now.
No, I'm not cold at all!
Just being with $$おにいちゃん$$ makes me feel all warm inside...
I want to stay with you... forever and ever...
Together... okay, $$おにいちゃん$$?
Huff... huff... M-my head... I've got a headache!
Yesterday...
you stayed right beside me the whole time...
That made me so, so happy!
But wow, I really felt awful!
Heehee... I'm okay now. Thanks to you, $$おにいちゃん$$!
But... if you go outside alone again... I won't sleep with you anymore!
Heehee! Do you remember what day today is?
Ta-daaa!
Here! Happy $$誕生日$$!
Hey, hey...!
I tried making a dish from a completely brand-new $$レシピ$$...
Ta-daaa!
Well? Well?!
Of course you'll eat it for me, won't you, $$おにいちゃん$$?!
Huff... huff... B-$$おにいちゃん$$...
My tummy's kind of...
It feels all rumble-rumble-kaBOOM, or something...
Huff... huff... U-ugh... I feel sick...
$$プリカ$$ isn't here!!
B-big brother! You're still awake—is that okay?!
Whaaat?! You're all better already?!
It's only been a week since you woke up!
Amazing! Amaaaazing!!
But I'm a little disappointed...
Because until just now, I felt like $$おにいちゃん$$'s $$おくさん$$!
Oh well!
Sooner or later!
But don't push yourself, $$おにいちゃん$$! It's okay to take your time getting better!
A-and... there's one important favor I need to ask...
$$おにいちゃん$$, will you listen?
This is important, so don't you dare forget!!
$$おにいちゃん$$, you were $$大ケガ$$,
and lost all your memories of this $$世界$$, right?!
So until I say it's okay, I want you to stay inside the house and not go out on your own!
Please, $$おにいちゃん$$! I'm begging you!
Let's do your $$リハビリ$$ together properly!
Hey, $$おにいちゃん$$...!
Do you remember what was special about today?!
